resources.string: See when a friend is online right now in Tetogram: “online · in Tetogram” appears in the chat header. The mark disappears a few minutes after they close the app, and only shows for people who keep “Show others” on.
This needs Tetogram\'s small presence server. Its code and setup guide are in the repository (server/presence). Paste its address here once it is deployed.
Show others that I\'m in Tetogram

While Tetogram is open, it tells the server every two minutes that you are here. Turn off to hide the mark from everyone. The server keeps only your Telegram ID and the time of the signal, in memory, for a few minutes; it does see which people you check.
